name: runA_haiku
bash_commands: ls -la && find . -path ./target -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat Cargo.toml && cargo --version && cargo fmt --check 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | head -150; echo "---"; cargo test 2>&1 | head -150
cat -n src/lib.rs && echo ---MAIN && cat -n src/main.rs && echo ---PY && cat -n python_src/wordstats.py && echo ---SPEC && cat -n tests/spec.rs && echo ---SETTINGS && cat .claude/settings.json

echo "== fmt --check"; cargo fmt --check 2>&1 | head -40; echo "fmt exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "== clippy"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -60; echo "clippy exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "== test"; cargo test 2>&1 | tail -80; echo "test exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

echo "== fmt --check"; cargo fmt --check > /tmp/fmt.log 2>&1; echo "fmt exit: $?"; head -40 /tmp/fmt.log; echo "== clippy"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings > /tmp/clippy.log 2>&1; echo "clippy exit: $?"; tail -60 /tmp/clippy.log; echo "== test"; cargo test > /tmp/test.log 2>&1; echo "test exit: $?"; tail -80 /tmp/test.log
cargo fmt --check; echo "fmt exit=$?"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "clippy exit=$?"; cargo test >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "test exit=$?"; mkdir -p reports
mkdir -p reports && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
